Tax-Forfeited Lands
The Otter Tail County Auditor-Treasurer’s Office administers the disposition of tax-forfeited lands. These are properties that, after three years of non-payment of taxes from the judgment year default to State of Minnesota ownership. Otter Tail County periodically holds sales of tax-forfeited lands. Properties are sold at public sale to the highest bidder by the County Auditor. Any lands not sold at the public sale will be auctioned again at a later date.
Next sale: Starts September 15 at 8:00 a.m.
Refer to the sales catalog for instructions, fees, and property listings.

Prohibited Bidders/Buyers
Anyone with delinquent real or personal property taxes in Otter Tail County is prohibited from purchasing state tax forfeited land. If you are interested in purchasing tax-forfeited property, you must pay all your delinquent taxes prior to bidding or purchasing.
Property Sales with Surplus with an Unexpired Claims Period
Per Minnesota Statute 282.005 , subdivision 6, sale proceeds in excess of the minimum bid are available for distribution to interested parties that make claim within six month of first notice of the surplus.
